banner.title: The policy changed after this claim was verified
banner.body: The policy snapshot this claim was verified against has been superseded.
banner.keepsOld: The claim keeps its current coverage basis until you decide to keep it or adopt the new one.

compare.notInForce: The policy is not in force in this version.

decision.title: Re-verification decision
decision.intro: Nothing changes on the claim until you decide. The decision and your reason are recorded.
decision.label: Decision

KEEP.label: Keep the current basis
KEEP.help: The claim stays verified against the snapshot it has today.

ADOPT.label: Adopt the new snapshot
ADOPT.help: The claim is verified against the new snapshot. Exposures that lose cover are flagged and new payments on them are blocked.

codes.LOSS_BEFORE_CHANGE: The loss happened before the change
codes.CHANGE_NOT_MATERIAL: The change does not affect this claim
codes.CHANGE_APPLIES: The change applies to this loss

errors.decision: Choose to keep or to adopt.

done.KEEP: The current coverage basis was kept.
done.ADOPT: The new policy snapshot was adopted.

reverify.failed: The decision could not be recorded

noPermission.title: You cannot take this decision
noPermission.body: Taking a coverage decision needs the claims handler authority. Ask a claims handler to review it.

problems.generic: The decision could not be recorded. Try again, or ask a colleague.
problems.CLM-ERR-SNAPSHOT-MISMATCH: The policy changed again while you were deciding. The claim was refreshed: review the comparison and decide again.
problems.CLM-ERR-STALE: The claim changed meanwhile. It was refreshed: review it and decide again.
problems.CLM-ERR-ILLEGAL-TRANSITION: No re-verification is pending on this claim any more.
problems.CLM-ERR-AUTHORITY: You do not have the authority to take this decision. Ask a claims handler.

reverify.compareUnavailable: The decision is available once both versions can be shown.
